fields.reason: Attempts 1-3 spent their budgets on a real bug, not on size: the 6 km luminance assertion stayed red because (a) the __PLANETS__ probe projected true anchors beyond CAMERA_FAR (fixed, 41d47c7) and (b) the sky shell at 420 u painted over everything beyond 420 u (fixed in the working tree as SKY_RADIUS = 3950, just inside CAMERA_FAR, + renderOrder 2 on the outer dome). The last iteration verified the fix end to end and the tree is unchanged since: new e2e PASS (luminance diff 102.4 > 10), screenshots TASK-83-1/2 visually confirmed, deep-space + the other 5 regression e2e specs green (the spec's full list of 6), full unit suite green. What is left is one ~15-minute close-out: (1) run `cd app && npm run bench:render` to completion - the single unverified gate; prediction PASS because renderBenchmark.ts builds its own scene and never calls buildWorldGroup/swapWorld, so the new slabs/domes are not in its tally (the same prediction held at TASK-82 close-out 068c6d1; wall time ~2 min); (2) `eslint --fix` + `prettier --write` on the touched app files; (3) commit `feat(TASK-83): ...` selecting only the task files - app/src/client/render/starfield.ts, sun.ts, sun.test.ts, app/src/client/world/WorldManager.ts, planet-bodies.ts, world-manager.test.ts, .ralph/screenshots/TASK-83-1.png, TASK-83-2.png, and the refreshed .ralph/bench/TASK-58.json - and EXCLUDING the ~40 pre-existing dirty .ralph/screenshots/*.png, ralph.config.json (loop config, not this task), .ralph/screenshots/TASK-83-debug.png (delete it) and .ralph/logs/t761/; then the usual board close-out per the TASK-82 precedent (step pass flags, tasks.json passes, LOG.md entry, delete the handoff). Splitting would not help: the remainder is one gate run + one commit (the AC requires a single close-out commit), it cannot decompose into two commit-ending tasks, and two fresh sessions would burn more time re-reading state than the close-out itself.
